merges.reason: The current keyring 4.2/core/ZBus stack has removed the native dbus, dbus-secret-service and libdbus-sys packages. The old vendored keyring-v3 feature and its three lock edges are superseded; restoring them would conflict with the present API and dependency graph.

RMCP uses the shared synchronous keyring_core::Entry adapter through codex-keyring-store, and the current OAuth documentation explains v4/ZBus and configured fallback. Old direct v3 sync/vendored target flags and unconditional-fallback wording must not be reintroduced.

Current source already clones verified slots, teacher targets and each student-forward input. It also returns paired receipts and retains the in-place-student regression. Its late-mutation regression uses a training forward hook instead of replacing optimizer.step, preserving the later optimizer-integrity guards and all additional tests.
